rules.industry_earnings: profit trend confirmed OR earnings improving OR strong revenue with non-negative profit and >=45% improving breadth
rules.industry_market: FUNDS_ENTERING from broad active participation OR FUNDS_ATTENTION from broad relative resilience/participation
rules.leading_prosperity: not claimed by repository gate; must be confirmed later from public leading indicators
rules.valuation: PE/PB retained as risk context; no PE hard ceiling
rules.technical_structure: keep broad non-overheated base/transition/trend/pullback/breakout states; lifecycle quality is evaluated later
rules.data_or_trend_incomplete: report_date + usable valuation context + >=20 trend points + 60d structure required

method.trend: cross-sectional MA20 participation plus median 20d stock return
